title: mirror_timer
summary: Benilla decodes the three mirror-timer packets (SMSG_START_MIRROR_TIMER u32 type/remaining/duration/i32 scale/u8 paused/u32 spellId; SMSG_PAUSE_MIRROR_TIMER; SMSG_STOP_MIRROR_TIMER) driving the breath/fatigue/feign-death bars, with START treated as idempotent re-statement. MSUI has no reference to any mirror-timer opcode outside the opcode table and no breath/fatigue bar consumer.

openItems.text: SMSG_START_MIRROR_TIMER not parsed (including the signed scale field and START-as-full-restate semantics)
No breath/fatigue/feign-death bar state or client-side integration of remaining_ms between packets
